import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep metrics by occupation
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sleep_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation')[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']].mean()
sleep_metrics.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, width=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Score / Hours')
ax1.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax1.legend(['Sleep Duration (hrs)', 'Sleep Quality (1-10)'])
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Physical activity vs sleep quality scatter
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], s=df['Daily Steps']/100, 
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Sleep Quality', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level')

# 3. BMI category distribution with sleep disorders
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
bmi_disorder = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] != ''].groupby('BMI Category').size()
bmi_disorder.plot(kind='pie', autopct='%1.1f%%', ax=ax3, startangle=90,
                  colors=['#ff9999','#66b3ff','#99ff99'])
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorders by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('')

# 4. Health metrics comparison
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
health_metrics = ['Heart Rate', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']
health_data = df[health_metrics].mean()
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(health_metrics)), health_data, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_title('Average Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(health_metrics)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(['Heart Rate\n(bpm)', 'Systolic BP\n(mmHg)', 'Diastolic BP\n(mmHg)'])
ax4.set_ylabel('Value')

# Add value labels on bars
for bar, value in zip(bars, health_data):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'{value:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 5. Daily steps distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
steps_by_occupation = df.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values()
bars = ax5.barh(range(len(steps_by_occupation)), steps_by_occupation.values, 
                color='#95D5B2', edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(steps_by_occupation)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(steps_by_occupation.index)

# Add value labels
for i, (bar, value) in enumerate(zip(bars, steps_by_occupation.values)):
    ax5.text(value + 100, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
             f'{value:.0f}', va='center', fontweight='bold')

# 6. Correlation heatmap
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level',
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
heatmap = sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm',
                      center=0, square=True, linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
